depiction.primary_object: house outline with a gable roof
modifiers: radio tower antenna with two concentric signal waves in bottom right
depiction.composition: single object with overlapping bottom-right badge

readings.meaning: smart home / home automation / connected home
home Wi-Fi / home wireless network / mesh router

ambiguity: At small sizes the antenna badge can look like a keyhole or a person standing next to a house, or be confused with a plain Wi-Fi fan icon on a house.

modifier_semantics.modifier: radio antenna with concentric signal arcs
modifier_semantics.meaning: wireless connection, broadcast signal, Wi-Fi, or smart-home connectivity

task_intents: configure smart home hub or automation
troubleshoot dead zones in house Wi-Fi
pair smart devices to home network

reasoning: Shows a house outline combined with a broadcasting antenna, clearly representing home Wi-Fi, home internet, or a smart/connected home. It fits real household tasks around routers, ISP bills, and home automation hubs, though the antenna badge looks very similar to a podcast icon when viewed out of context.
